method.gaps: 2026-10-07 has broker totals only; windows spanning it understate flow. 180/365-day windows are partial before the archive start 2026-07-15.
method.impact: Window return (pp) / net buying (Rs crore). Descriptive: price moved alongside flow, not proof flow caused it.
method.prices: Adjusted-final closes; raw closes where no adjusted bar exists. Ex-dates never fake a push.
method.push_share: Pusher net amount / total net buying (sum of all positive broker nets) x 100. Broker nets sum to zero, so net buying is the buying side of that split.
method.pusher: Brokers with net buying in the window, ranked by net amount; lead pusher is rank 1.
method.skill_flag: From the published Broker Smart Money board: the lead pusher marked skilled when it sits in that board's skilled cohort. Absent payload => null.
